corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the labiovelar ring of 'ጕ' (ጕንደ), not 'ጉ'.
The printed word is the archaic Andemta feminine gerundive 'ሁና' (ሁና ተሠርታለችና), misread as 'ዑና'.
The 6th-order 'ስ' in 'ለንስሐ' is clearly printed and grammatically required.
The printed glyph is labiovelar 'ቈ' (ይቈርጡታል), with the horizontal crossbar and loop.
Canonical Ge'ez pronoun 'አነሰኬ' (1st order 'ነ', 'I indeed'), misread as 6th order 'ን'.

corrections.corrected_text: ት ። ዘቦ ፪ኤ ክዳናተ የሀብ ፩↵
corrections.reason: Ge'ez accusative plural 'ክዳናተ' (Luke 3:11) has 1st order 'ተ' without the 6th-order left tick.
Traditional tax-collector idiom 'አንበሳ ወይቆ የወርቅ ተኩስ'; the middle character is 'ይ' (with right hook), not 'ደ'.
The printed word is 'የጐመን' (cabbage tax: የጐመን መንጃ), misread as 'የጎሙን'.
Ge'ez jussive 'ኢትሂዱ' ('do not plunder/rob by force', Luke 3:14) is printed with 3rd-order 'ሂ', not 5th-order 'ሄ'.
Traditional Andemta analogy 'ለእድ ቢረዜን ለልብስ ገላን እንዲያጽቡለት' ('just as they wash biräzen for a stain [እድ] and the body for a garment'); printed glyph is 6th-order 'ድ', not 'ጁ'.
The printed word 'አሣዕኖ' begins with 'አ' (two legs), not 'ዓ'.
The printed word is 'ያመጣል' (paralleling 'ያመጣልና' two lines below); the three-legged 'ጣ' was misread as 'ጻ'.
